title: Fix unreachable firmware-installer payload check
description: Update .codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh to remove or replace the linux-firmware/WHENCE check that cannot exist in firmware-installer artifacts because k/firmware-installer/SLKBUILD removes $PKG/linux-firmware before packaging.

comments.author: Hunter Jozwiak
comments.text: Review source: /home/sektor/projects/slackbuilds/.codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh:189. Finding [P2]: firmware-installer validator requires linux-firmware/WHENCE, but k/firmware-installer/SLKBUILD removes /linux-firmware before packaging, causing false FAIL on valid artifacts. Replace with a shipped path (e.g., WHENCE.linux-firmware) or drop the check.

comments.author: Hunter Jozwiak
comments.text:
Review finding literal context:
- File: /home/sektor/projects/slackbuilds/.codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh:189
- Severity: P2
- The firmware-installer validator currently requires linux-firmware/WHENCE.
- k/firmware-installer/SLKBUILD removes $PKG/linux-firmware before packaging, so that path cannot exist in final .txz artifacts.
- Result: systematic false FAIL for valid firmware-installer builds.
- Fix: remove that check or switch to a shipped path such as WHENCE.linux-firmware.

title: Add regression coverage for firmware-installer validation
description: Add a guard in validation logic/tests so firmware-installer checks only assert paths that are shipped in the .txz (for example doc payload like WHENCE.linux-firmware), preventing recurring false FAIL results.
